audience: sales and service teams that keep persons, organisations, opportunities and support cases in webCRM

useCases.title: Find a person and their organisation
useCases.text: Search persons by name, e-mail or phone. Open the person, then the organisation, to read the record details.

useCases.title: Review opportunities by pipeline stage
useCases.text: List the pipelines to find a level id. List the opportunities at that level, then open one to see its owner and details.

useCases.title: Check support cases and meetings for a week
useCases.text: List the support cases and open one by its id. List the meetings between two dates, optionally for one user.

useCases.title: Log a follow-up call and its notes
useCases.text: Create an activity, a task, call or meeting, on a person, organisation or opportunity. Add a note to an existing activity to record the outcome.
